providers.providerName: Robert Shiller Online Data, Yale University
providers.licensePolicy: No explicit redistribution license is asserted by this project; retain raw bytes locally, cite the source, and publish only derived aggregate research results.

series.endpointSemantics: Versioned-by-local-hash workbook downloaded from the Yale Online Data page.
series.fieldSemantics: Monthly S&P composite price, dividend, earnings, CPI, long interest rate, real series and CAPE; price is a monthly average rather than an ETF month-end execution price.
series.publicationBehavior: Workbook is updated in place; historical publication timestamps are not supplied per observation.
series.revisionBehavior: The workbook may be revised or extended and has no first-release vintage API; every downloaded byte sequence must therefore be pinned.
series.licenseRestriction: Local research archive only; do not redistribute the workbook.
series.missingnessPolicy: Preserve blank, NA, and nonnumeric cells as explicit missing values and report each field's coverage.
series.decisionReason: Provides long-run valuation discovery, but monthly-average endpoints and unavailable publication vintages prohibit use as actual SPY/QQQ confirmation or promotion evidence.

providers.providerName: Federal Reserve Economic Data and Archival FRED
providers.licensePolicy: Honor FRED API terms plus every underlying series restriction; store raw responses locally and include source citations in derived reports.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=DGS3MO, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 100 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from the returned change events.
series.fieldSemantics: Daily market yield on three-month U.S. Treasury securities at constant maturity, percent per annum, quoted on an investment basis, not seasonally adjusted.
series.publicationBehavior: H.15 observations are used only after their ALFRED real-time start or recorded release date is at or before the snapshot cutoff.
series.revisionBehavior: All observations are acquired with real-time intervals; later revisions do not overwrite earlier vintage records.
series.licenseRestriction: Public-domain source with citation requested; FRED API terms still apply.
series.missingnessPolicy: Dot values, weekends, and holidays remain missing; select the latest previously published nonmissing observation without looking forward.
series.decisionReason: Long enough for SPY and QQQ validation and compatible with the preregistered observable monthly cash proxy.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=CPIAUCSL, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 100 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from the returned change events.
series.publicationBehavior: A month's value becomes available only at its recorded ALFRED real-time start, normally in the following month.
series.revisionBehavior: Seasonal factors and history can be revised; retain all real-time intervals and select the vintage known at each cutoff.
series.licenseRestriction: BLS public-domain source with citation requested; FRED API terms still apply.
series.missingnessPolicy: Do not forward-fill past the last vintage published by the cutoff; report unavailable real-price rows.
series.decisionReason: ALFRED real-time intervals support vintage-aware feature deflation; a separately pinned latest vintage is used only for realized labels.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=NFCI, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 10 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from the returned change events.
series.fieldSemantics: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index, weekly ending Friday; positive values indicate tighter-than-average conditions and negative values looser-than-average conditions.
series.publicationBehavior: Usually released weekly after the observation week; the exact ALFRED real-time start controls availability.
series.revisionBehavior: The complete history can change with incoming data, source revisions, and re-estimated weights; historical snapshots must use ALFRED vintages, never the latest reconstructed curve.
series.licenseRestriction: Copyrighted, citation required; accepted for local nonredistributed research only under the source download offering and site terms.
series.missingnessPolicy: Use only the latest nonmissing weekly observation whose real-time start is at or before cutoff; no look-ahead interpolation.
series.decisionReason: Long history and archived real-time intervals provide the frozen stress input without the storage prohibition attached to Moody's BAA data.

series.endpointSemantics: Enumerate /fred/series/vintagedates through the frozen as-of date, then request /fred/series/observations with series_id=INDPRO, file_type=json, units=lin, sort_order=asc, output_type=3, and deterministic batches of exactly 10 vintage dates except the final remainder; reconstruct real-time intervals from the returned change events.
series.fieldSemantics: Monthly seasonally adjusted Industrial Production: Total Index, current base 2017=100.
series.publicationBehavior: A month's value is admitted only from the first ALFRED real-time interval known by cutoff.
series.revisionBehavior: Values and historical index levels are revised; retain every returned real-time interval and reconstruct each cutoff.
series.licenseRestriction: Federal Reserve Board public-domain source with citation requested; FRED API terms still apply.
series.missingnessPolicy: No backfill from a later release; six-month growth is unavailable unless both endpoint values existed by cutoff.
series.decisionReason: Long ALFRED-compatible history supports the preregistered point-in-time macro-direction input.

series.endpointSemantics: Moody's Seasoned Baa Corporate Bond Yield distributed through FRED.
series.fieldSemantics: Monthly percent yield on seasoned Baa-rated long-maturity corporate bonds.
series.publicationBehavior: Not evaluated further after the license gate failed.
series.revisionBehavior: Not evaluated further after the license gate failed.
series.licenseRestriction: Moody's series notes prohibit copying, redistribution, and storage for subsequent use without prior written consent.
series.decisionReason: The storage restriction is incompatible with the required immutable raw archive; preregistration v2 replaced this input before acquisition or modeling.

providers.licensePolicy: Use existing credentials for internal research only, retain raw responses locally, and do not redistribute exchange-derived market data.

series.endpointSemantics: Multi-symbol daily bars for SPY and QQQ with timeframe=1Day, feed=sip, adjustment=raw, ascending order and explicit UTC bounds.
series.fieldSemantics: Timestamped daily OHLCV bars from the consolidated SIP feed; timestamps identify bar intervals and do not provide historical first-seen or revision lineage.
series.publicationBehavior: Historical backfill is queried after the fact and is marked event-time-only.
series.revisionBehavior: No Databento-style revision lineage; every response page and request identity is pinned and never overwritten.
series.licenseRestriction: Internal use under the existing Alpaca/exchange data agreement; no raw redistribution.
series.missingnessPolicy: Compare expected XNYS sessions with returned bars; never synthesize prices and report all gaps.
series.decisionReason: Provides actual tradable SPY/QQQ history; acquisition must prove enough daily history for 120 training months, 12-month embargo, and 96 complete confirmation labels independently.

series.endpointSemantics: Market-data corporate actions for SPY and QQQ, including forward/reverse splits, cash dividends, stock dividends and capital-gains distributions over explicit date bounds.
series.fieldSemantics: Issuer corporate-action records used to construct a transparent total-return index; this is not an account-activity query.
series.publicationBehavior: Current historical event archive; original announcement first-seen history may be unavailable.
series.revisionBehavior: Pin raw responses and exclude any event whose effective/ex-date semantics cannot be normalized unambiguously.
series.licenseRestriction: Internal use under the existing Alpaca data agreement; no raw redistribution.
series.missingnessPolicy: Coverage must reconcile with provider-adjusted comparison bars and known distribution counts; unresolved discrepancies fail the instrument dataset.
series.decisionReason: Avoids opaque adjusted-close dependence and account activity, subject to full-history coverage and reconciliation gates.

providers.licensePolicy: Public product pages and dated fact sheets may be cited but are not treated as a reproducible historical valuation database.

series.endpointSemantics: Current product page and intermittently dated fact sheets, not a stable point-in-time valuation API.
series.fieldSemantics: Current or document-date portfolio valuation statistics whose constituent methodology and complete historical snapshots are not exposed as a reproducible series.
series.publicationBehavior: Current pages change and archived fact-sheet completeness is not guaranteed.
series.revisionBehavior: No complete vintage history or stable machine-readable revision lineage was identified.
series.licenseRestriction: No permission to construct and redistribute a historical valuation database is assumed.
series.decisionReason: Fails history, stable endpoint, vintage provenance, and reproducibility requirements; QQQ uses only its preregistered structural-price valuation input.

runtimeCoverageGates.confirmationResolutionRule: For each instrument, reserve the final 96 months with complete 12-month labels after all core-source coverage gates pass; record exact dates in the dataset manifest without changing scientific fields.

protectedFieldPolicy: Any preregistration hash change invalidates this audit and requires a new source audit before feature computation.
